observed_problem: 1402px document width at both 1280px and 390px viewports; clipping visible

recurring_effort: Retest after template changes; about 15 min/month within QA allowance
verification_method: Repeat 390px test; broaden 320/768/1280; no ordinary horizontal scrolling

observed_problem: Three H4 headings; no H1–H3; four book images missing alt attributes

recurring_effort: Check new media/templates in weekly QA

dependency: Confirmed logistics and event access policy
verification_method: Next dated activity or checked empty state reached within two links
